en.summary: Manage local publishing plans and the protected developer service
en.usage:
Usage:
  px-plugin publisher plan create --entry <workspace> --version <SemVer> [--notes-file <file>] [--channel stable] [--os linux] [--arch amd64]
  px-plugin publisher plan list --entry <workspace> [--page 1] [--size 20]
  px-plugin publisher plan get --entry <workspace> --id <UUID>
  px-plugin publisher serve --entry <workspace> --origin <development-origin> [--listen 127.0.0.1:0]

Builds require a Linux/amd64 executor and a pure-JavaScript Node runtime. Upload and review are not registered.

  px-plugin publisher build run --entry <workspace> --plan-id <UUID>
  px-plugin publisher build list --entry <workspace>
  px-plugin publisher build get|verify|logs --entry <workspace> --id <UUID>
en.flag.entry: Trusted plugin workspace containing a regular plugin.yaml
en.flag.version: Stable SemVer version without a leading v
en.flag.channel: Release channel; this version accepts stable
en.flag.os: Planned operating system; this version accepts linux
en.flag.arch: Planned architecture; this version accepts amd64
en.flag.notes: UTF-8 release notes file; at most 10000 bytes
en.flag.listen: Loopback IP and port; port 0 selects a free port
en.flag.origin: Exact loopback development origin allowed to use the service
en.PUBLISHER_INVALID_INPUT: Invalid publishing input; check the field or command parameters.
en.PUBLISHER_INVALID_WORKSPACE: The workspace does not contain a valid plugin manifest.
en.PUBLISHER_WORKSPACE_CHANGED: The workspace identity or source version changed; reopen the publishing tool.
en.PUBLISHER_INVALID_RECORD: A local publishing record is invalid; inspect the stored record before continuing.
en.PUBLISHER_STORAGE_FAILURE: Local publishing storage or service startup failed; check permissions and workspace state.
en.PUBLISHER_NOT_FOUND: The requested local publishing resource was not found.
en.PUBLISHER_CONFLICT: The local executor is already running or the record already exists.
en.PUBLISHER_UNAUTHORIZED: The local tool credential is missing, invalid, expired or already consumed.
en.PUBLISHER_FORBIDDEN: The request host or origin is not allowed.
en.PUBLISHER_UNSUPPORTED_PLATFORM: Local publishing storage is currently supported on Linux and macOS.
en.PUBLISHER_REQUEST_TOO_LARGE: The local publishing request exceeds the size limit.
en.PUBLISHER_MEDIA_TYPE_REQUIRED: The local request must use application/json.
en.PUBLISHER_METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED: This operation does not accept the requested HTTP method.
en.PUBLISHER_BUILD_PLATFORM_REQUIRED: Use a Linux/amd64 executor with a matching Node runtime for this build.
en.PUBLISHER_BUILD_BUSY: Another build owns this workspace; wait for it to finish or cancel it through its owner.
en.PUBLISHER_BUILD_FAILED: The isolated build failed; inspect its redacted diagnostics and task stage.
en.PUBLISHER_BUILD_SOURCE_CHANGED: Build inputs changed during the task; create a new build from the intended source.
en.PUBLISHER_BUILD_SOURCE_UNSAFE: The build input, path, dependency or snapshot does not meet the isolated build contract.
en.PUBLISHER_ARTIFACT_INVALID: The package identity, target, runtime, version or referenced resource failed validation.
en.PUBLISHER_ARTIFACT_CHANGED: The frozen artifact is missing or its bytes no longer match the recorded digest.
en.PUBLISHER_NATIVE_RUNTIME_UNVERIFIED: This profile requires a CGO-free Go backend and pure JavaScript frontend; native runtime files are blocked.
en.PUBLISHER_BUILD_CANCELLED: The build was cancelled or reached its time budget.

zh.summary: 管理本地发布计划与受保护的开发工具服务
zh.usage:
用法：
  px-plugin publisher plan create --entry <工作区> --version <SemVer> [--notes-file <文件>] [--channel stable] [--os linux] [--arch amd64]
  px-plugin publisher plan list --entry <工作区> [--page 1] [--size 20]
  px-plugin publisher plan get --entry <工作区> --id <UUID>
  px-plugin publisher serve --entry <工作区> --origin <开发站点来源> [--listen 127.0.0.1:0]

构建需要 Linux/amd64 执行器及纯 JavaScript Node 运行时；上传和送审尚未注册。

  px-plugin publisher build run --entry <workspace> --plan-id <UUID>
  px-plugin publisher build list --entry <workspace>
  px-plugin publisher build get|verify|logs --entry <workspace> --id <UUID>
zh.flag.entry: 包含有效普通 plugin.yaml 文件的受信插件工作区
zh.flag.version: 不带 v 前缀的正式 SemVer 版本
zh.flag.channel: 发布渠道，当前仅接受 stable
zh.flag.os: 计划目标操作系统，当前仅接受 linux
zh.flag.arch: 计划目标架构，当前仅接受 amd64
zh.flag.notes: UTF-8 更新说明文件，最多 10000 字节
zh.flag.size: 每页数量，范围为 1 至 100
zh.flag.listen: 回环 IP 与端口，端口 0 自动选择空闲端口
zh.flag.origin: 允许访问服务的完整回环开发站点来源
zh.PUBLISHER_INVALID_INPUT: 发布输入无效，请检查字段或命令参数。
zh.PUBLISHER_INVALID_WORKSPACE: 工作区缺少有效的插件清单。
zh.PUBLISHER_WORKSPACE_CHANGED: 工作区插件身份或源码声明版本已变化，请重新打开发布工具。
zh.PUBLISHER_INVALID_RECORD: 本地发布记录无效，请先核对存储记录。
zh.PUBLISHER_STORAGE_FAILURE: 本地发布存储或服务启动失败，请检查权限和工作区状态。
zh.PUBLISHER_NOT_FOUND: 未找到请求的本地发布资源。
zh.PUBLISHER_CONFLICT: 本地执行器已运行，或目标记录已经存在。
zh.PUBLISHER_UNAUTHORIZED: 本地工具凭据缺失、无效、已到期或已使用。
zh.PUBLISHER_FORBIDDEN: 请求的 Host 或 Origin 不在允许范围内。
zh.PUBLISHER_UNSUPPORTED_PLATFORM: 本地发布存储当前支持 Linux 与 macOS。
zh.PUBLISHER_REQUEST_TOO_LARGE: 本地发布请求超过大小限制。
zh.PUBLISHER_MEDIA_TYPE_REQUIRED: 本地请求必须使用 application/json。
zh.PUBLISHER_METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED: 此操作不接受请求中的 HTTP 方法。
zh.PUBLISHER_BUILD_PLATFORM_REQUIRED: 此构建需要具备匹配 Node 运行时的 Linux/amd64 执行器。
zh.PUBLISHER_BUILD_BUSY: 此工作区已有构建任务，请等待完成或通过所属执行器取消。
zh.PUBLISHER_BUILD_FAILED: 隔离构建失败，请查看任务阶段及脱敏诊断。
zh.PUBLISHER_BUILD_SOURCE_CHANGED: 构建期间输入发生变化，请基于目标源码重新构建。
zh.PUBLISHER_BUILD_SOURCE_UNSAFE: 构建输入、路径、依赖或源码副本不符合隔离构建契约。
zh.PUBLISHER_ARTIFACT_INVALID: 安装包身份、目标、运行时、版本或引用资源未通过校验。
zh.PUBLISHER_ARTIFACT_CHANGED: 冻结产物缺失，或实际字节与记录摘要不一致。
zh.PUBLISHER_NATIVE_RUNTIME_UNVERIFIED: 当前构建配置要求无 CGO 的 Go 后端与纯 JavaScript 前端，未验证的原生运行文件已阻断。
zh.PUBLISHER_BUILD_CANCELLED: 构建已取消或超过执行时限。
zh.flag.plan_id: 要构建的发布计划 UUID
